source.name: IBSI 2 - Standardised convolutional filtering for Radiomics
notes: This file is a normalized machine-readable transcription of IBSI-2 benchmark Tables 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4 and 6.5, with phase 2 reference values embedded from the provided CSV.
Top-level configs correspond to IBSI-2 phase 2 feature benchmark configurations for the PAT1 lung cancer CT image and are intended for direct feature-value testing.

Reference values are available in the provided CSV for filter IDs 1.A through 9.B only. Configurations 10.A through 11.B are retained but marked reference_values_available=false because no usable consensus reference values are present in the CSV/manual tables.
For phase 1 response-map benchmarking, compare the entire response map against the official NIfTI reference maps rather than the scalar statistical features.
